synopsis: Ever since the emergence of Phantom Star mutated plants and animals on earth into deadly monsters called beast gods, humanity has been on the brink of being wiped out. It was only when explorers who traveled to Phantom Star returned with formidable power that humans were able to start fighting back. Like countless others, Jiang Kai also traveled to Phantom Star in hopes of earning great strength. However, after overcoming brutal conditions and bloodthirsty monsters, he discovers that his profession is a gambler, a rare job that is not granted so easily. (Source: Tappytoon)

title: 1LDK to Futari
synopsis: Your "welcome home" is the perfect remedy. Tsukasa Shiozaki has secretly been in love with Yukihito Kuze, a regular at the restaurant where he works who often comes in with his girlfriend. Watching them look so happy together always reminds Tsukasa that his feelings are one-sided, and he's long since given up on confessing. But one day everything changes. “If you don't have anywhere to go, why not come to my place?” With that sudden invitation made to Yukihito, Tsukasa’s ordinary life takes an unexpected turn. (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Notes: - All chapters were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases. All Bangai-hen (番外編) published on Pixiv Comic were not included in any of the volumes. - Includes five extra chapters.

title: LOST MAN
synopsis: There lives a man who has lost his memory and can’t remember where he’s from, and who he is, including his name. He just goes by the name Matsumoto and the one and only thing he remembers is how to play soccer. However, the one thing he does remember, he does exceptionally well, even better than the professionals. He sells his ridiculous soccer skills to teams and guarantees them goals and, even more important, wins. As he travels from city to city, country to country playing for money, he hopes that he regains his memory.

title: Bad Girl
synopsis: What does one do when you have a crush on the president of the public morals club? Well, if you're first-year high school student Yuu, the answer is turning to a life of delinquency! In a bid for the president's heart, Yuu becomes a self-described "bad girl" hoping to thrill and excite her crush. But Yuu's adorableness (despite her best efforts) outshines any attempts to come off otherwise-and the president can't see past that tiny, adorable exterior. What's a girl got to do to get in trouble around here?! (Source: Yen Press)
